name: @semio/behavior-editor
description: An editor for Arora behavior trees and their detached nodes: a diagram and the text language side by side, run against a device or a mock.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build wasm --target web --release --no-pack --out-dir pkg --out-name behavior_text -- --locked && rm -f wasm/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build:device: wasm-pack build device --target web --dev --no-pack --out-dir pkg --out-name dataflow_device -- --locked && rm -f device/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build: tsup --entry.index src/index.ts --entry.websocket src/websocket/index.ts --entry.styles src/styles.css --format esm,cjs --dts.entry.index src/index.ts --dts.entry.websocket src/websocket/index.ts --external react
scripts.dev: tsup --entry.index src/index.ts --entry.websocket src/websocket/index.ts --entry.styles src/styles.css --format esm,cjs --watch --dts.entry.index src/index.ts --dts.entry.websocket src/websocket/index.ts --external react
scripts.lint:rust: cd wasm && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check && cd ../device && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
scripts.test:rust: cd wasm && cargo test --locked --release && cd ../device && cargo test --locked
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules dist wasm/pkg wasm/target device/pkg device/target
